issues.description: Duplicate React imports in apps/web/app/design/step-3/page.tsx — 'useState' and 'useEffect' are imported twice causing a build failure (Module build failed). This causes Fast Refresh failures and RSC payload fetch errors visible in console logs.
issues.root_cause: The file has two import lines from 'react': line 2 imports { useState, useEffect } and line 4 imports { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState }, resulting in duplicate named imports that the SWC compiler rejects.

issues.description: Repeated React hydration errors ('Text content does not match server-rendered HTML') causing the entire root to fall back to client rendering. This is likely triggered by the build error in step-3 causing cascading Fast Refresh failures and broken RSC payloads for /auth.
issues.root_cause: The build failure in step-3/page.tsx causes Fast Refresh to fail and RSC payloads to return 404, which then triggers browser navigation fallback and hydration mismatches across pages including /auth.

fixes.old_str:
"use client"
import { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef } from "react";
fixes.new_str:
"use client"
import { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef } from "react";
fixes.reason: This is already the correct single merged import. The actual file content shows a duplicate import pattern. The fix below removes the duplicate by keeping only one consolidated import line.

fixes.new_str:
"use client"
import { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef } from "react";
fixes.reason: Removes the duplicate React import lines. The first import line had useState and useEffect, and the second line re-imported them along with useCallback and useRef. Merging into a single import fixes the SWC build error.
